# key: # ---- Emulator assistant (2.2): detected emulators, one-click connect and window binding. Prefix: Emu_ ----

zh-CN: 没有检测到正在运行的模拟器。启动 MuMu、雷电、夜神、逍遥、蓝叠或 Android Studio 模拟器后点击右上角“检测模拟器”。
en-US: No running emulator detected. Start MuMu, LDPlayer, Nox, MEmu, BlueStacks or the Android Studio emulator, then click "Detect emulators" above.

zh-CN: 把这个模拟器窗口绑定为窗口设备：自动定位 Android 画面、关联 ADB 并保存模拟器档案。
en-US: Bind this emulator window as a window device: locates the Android screen, links ADB and saves an emulator profile.

zh-CN: 没有检测到正在运行的模拟器。
检测到 {0} 个正在运行的模拟器实例。

en-US: ADB is off in the emulator

zh-CN: 检测到的模拟器都已连接。
无法确定 {0} 的 ADB 端口。请确认模拟器已开启 ADB 调试，或在“添加无线设备”中手动输入地址。
en-US: Cannot tell the ADB port of {0}. Make sure ADB debugging is on in the emulator, or enter the address under "Add wireless device".

zh-CN: 请在模拟器设置中开启 ADB（蓝叠：设置 → 高级 → Android 调试桥）后重试。
en-US: Turn on ADB in the emulator's settings (BlueStacks: Settings → Advanced → Android Debug Bridge) and retry.

zh-CN: 请在雷电模拟器设置 → 其他设置中把“ADB 调试”设为“开启本地连接”后重试。
en-US: In LDPlayer settings → Other settings, set "ADB debugging" to "Open local connection" and retry.

zh-CN: 模拟器可能还在启动，请等系统进入桌面后重试。
en-US: The emulator may still be starting; retry once Android has booted.

zh-CN: 没有找到 {0} 的窗口。请先打开模拟器窗口。
en-US: No window found for {0}. Open the emulator window first.

zh-CN: {0} 的窗口已最小化。请先还原窗口再绑定。
en-US: The window of {0} is minimized. Restore it before binding.

zh-CN: 无法捕获 {0} 的窗口画面。
没能准确定位 {0} 的 Android 画面，请在向导中确认画面区域后保存。
en-US: Could not locate the Android screen of {0} reliably; check the screen area in the wizard and save.

zh-CN: 已绑定 {0} 的窗口（{1}），可以在投屏和自动化中使用。
en-US: Bound the window of {0} ({1}); it can now be used for mirroring and automation.

zh-CN: 已绑定 {0} 的窗口（{1}），但没有连上 ADB：只能截图识别，不能点击。
en-US: Bound the window of {0} ({1}) without ADB: it can be captured and matched but not tapped.
the whole window is the screen

en-US: located by the emulator's render window
